GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (ShrugItOff.cs:13) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.Self)` (ShrugItOff.cs:21-24) == cost 1 / SKILL / COMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(8m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(1)` (ShrugItOff.cs:15-19) == both numbers, both declared. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` FIRST (ShrugItOff.cs:28) == `BlockCmd.apply`, then `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` (29) == `DrawCmd.draw`. No animation on either side.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` (ShrugItOff.cs:34) == `self._block += 3` (8 -> 11). The CARDS var stays 1 when upgraded on both sides.
